
######################################################################
##### A_Note_For_Yourself
######################################################################

{{Frame|Take and Give}} {{TS|positive||Receive and Store a Card}}
* Receive a card that you had stored previously, and store a card in your deck in return.
** The first time the player encounters this event in their save file, it will have {{C|Iron Wave}} stored.
{{Frame|Ignore}} Nothing happens.
<br>
<br>
You are then given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.


######################################################################
##### Bonfire_Spirits
######################################################################

{{Frame|Offer}} Receive a reward based on the offer.
* Offer a card in your deck to remove. The reward you receive depends on the rarity of the card you give.

######################################################################
##### Match_and_Keep
######################################################################

{{Frame|Play}} 
* Play a matching game for cards. Match pairs of cards to add them to your deck. There is always a pair of one {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless}} card and one {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}.

######################################################################
##### We_Meet_Again_
######################################################################

{{Frame|Give Potion}} {{TS|negative||Lose a chosen potion.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* The event will randomly choose a potion upon entry and tell you which one was selected. You will be unable to drink or discard that potion until you leave the event's floor.

{{Frame|Give Gold}} {{TS|negative||Lose Gold.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* The amount of [[Gold]] lost is between 50 and 150 (or your current amount of [[Gold]]).

{{Frame|Give Card}} {{TS|negative||Lose a chosen card.}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a Relic.}}
* The chosen card will not be {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Basic|Basic}} or a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}.

{{Frame|Attack}} Nothing happens.


######################################################################
##### Wheel_of_Change
######################################################################

<div style="float:right; display:flex; flex-direction:row; gap:10px; margin:0 0 10px 10px;">
[[File:SpinButton.png|100px|thumb|Spin Button.]]
[[File:WheelArrow.png|100px|thumb|Wheel arrow.]]
[[File:Wheel.png|250px|thumb|Wheel.]]
</div>
{{Frame|Play}}
* Spin a wheel containing the following "prizes" (clockwise starting at 12 o'clock in the image):
** Take 10% ({{Asc|15|15%}}) of your Max HP as damage.
** Gain [[Gold]]
** Gain a random [[Relic]]
** Heal to full HP
** Become Cursed - {{C|Decay}}
** Remove a card from your deck.

{{Clear}}


######################################################################
##### Big_Fish
######################################################################

{{Frame|Banana}} {{TS|positive||Heal 1/3 of your max HP.}}
* If the player's HP is not divisble by 3, the HP gain is rounded down.
<br>
{{Frame|Donut}} {{TS|positive||Max HP +5.}}
* Like all HP gain, the extra hit points are healed when you get them.
<br>
{{Frame|Box}} {{TS|positive||Obtain a [[Relic]].}} {{TS|negative||Become Cursed - {{C|Regret}}.}}
* The {{QueryLink|Relics||Relic}} is a randomly selected {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Common|Common}}, {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Uncommon|Uncommon}}, or {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} Relic.
<br>
You are then given the option to {{Frame|Leave}}.


######################################################################
##### Dead_Adventurer
######################################################################

{{Frame|Search}} {{TS|positive||Find Loot.}} {{TS|negative||25%}} {{Asc|15|(35%)}}{{TS|negative||: monster returns.}}
* Each {{Frame|Search}} attempt will either cause an [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Act 1 Elite]] to return and fight the player, or yield one of the following rewards:
** 30 [[Gold]]
** A random [[Relic]]
** Nothing
* Each reward only occurs once - if the player's first search found nothing and the second search found the [[Relic]], the third search will either reward 30 [[Gold]] or start a battle.
* Each reward that is acquired before fighting the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] will be removed from its combat rewards if the player eventually does fight the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] and defeats it.
** For example, if the player's first {{Frame|Search}} is a [[Relic]], the [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] will not drop a [[Relic]] when it is defeated.
** This is also the reason why this specific [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] fight can drop 30 extra [[Gold]] compared to a normal [[Elite]]; because the 30 [[Gold]] {{Frame|Search}} reward is added to the normal [[Gold]] reward of defeating an [[Elite]].
* Each subsequent {{Frame|Search}} increases the chance to encounter an [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]] by 25%.
* If the player manages to successfully {{Frame|Search}} three times without encountering an  [[Elites#Act 1 Elites|Elite]], the event will end with a short dialogue detailing the success.
* For the second and third searches (assuming the player is not ambushed), {{Frame|Search}} will be called {{Frame|Continue}} instead. Its behavior and description are unchanged.
<br>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

######################################################################
##### Cursed_Tome
######################################################################

{{Frame|Read}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Continue}} {{TS|negative||Lose 1 HP.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Continue}} {{TS|negative||Lose 2 HP.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Continue}} {{TS|negative||Lose 3 HP.}}
<blockquote>
{{Frame|Take}} {{TS|positive||Obtain the book.}} {{TS|negative||Lose 10}} {{asc|15|(15)}} {{TS|negative||HP.}}
* The book may be {{R|Enchiridion}}, {{R|Nilry's Codex}}, or {{R|Necronomicon}}. The player does not know which book they will get until after they choose {{Frame|Take}} and lose their HP.
<br>
{{Frame|Stop}} {{TS|negative||Lose 3 HP.}}
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
{{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

=== Practical Options ===
Because the player can choose to leave the event immediately and lose 0 HP instead of selecting {{Frame|Continue}} 3 times and then backing out with {{Frame|Stop}} while losing a total of 9 HP, there are really only 2 practical ways to navigate the event. The player can either commit to all the HP loss and obtain the book, or leave immediately to do nothing.

For simplicity, the event's options can be thought of in this way instead:
* {{Frame|Read}}, then all 3 {{Frame|Continue}}, and finally {{Frame|Take}} {{TS|positive||Obtain the book.}} {{TS|negative||Lose 16}} {{asc|15|(21)}} {{TS|negative||HP.}} 
* {{Frame|Leave}} Nothing happens.

######################################################################
##### Knowing_Skull
######################################################################

The following options are presented to the player until they decide to leave the event. X is equal to 10% of the player's Max HP (minimum of 6 HP) plus the number of times they have chosen that specific option ({{TS|negative||Lose 6 HP}}, then {{TS|negative||Lose 7 HP}}, then {{TS|negative||Lose 8 HP}}, etc.)
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|A Pick Me Up?}} {{TS|positive||Get a [[Potion]].}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}} 
* A random [[Potion]] is immediately added to the player's left-most empty potion slot.
* The player is able to select this option even if all their potion slots are full or if they possess {{R|Sozu}}. They still lose HP and this option's HP loss is still increased by 1 even though no potion is obtained.

{{Frame|Riches?}} {{TS|positive||Gain 90 [[Gold]].}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Success?}} {{TS|positive||Get a}} {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless card}}. {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
* A random {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Uncommon&color:Colorless|Uncommon Colorless card}} is added to the player's deck.

{{Frame|How do I leave?}} {{TS|negative||Lose X HP.}}
* This event repeats until this option is chosen.

######################################################################
##### Falling
######################################################################

All options will randomly choose a card in the player's deck of a particular type. The option's text will explicitly tell the player which card they would lose. If the player lacks a card of a particular type, then the option relating to that type will be locked (e.g. if the player has no {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Power|Powers}} for the {{Frame|Channel}} option, it is replaced with the option {{Frame|Locked}} Requires: Power Card).
<br>
<br>
{{Frame|Land}} {{TS|negative||Lose <i>(a random</i>}} ''{{QueryLink|Cards|type:Skill|Skill}}''{{TS|negative||<i>)</i>}}
* Cannot be a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Skill|Skill}} targeted by {{R|Bottled Lightning}}.

{{Frame|Channel}} {{TS|negative||Lose <i>(a random</i>}} ''{{QueryLink|Cards|type:Power|Power}}''{{TS|negative||<i>)</i>}}
* Cannot be a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Power|Power}} targeted by {{R|Bottled Tornado}}.

{{Frame|Strike}} {{TS|negative||Lose <i>(a random</i>}} ''{{QueryLink|Cards|type:Attack|Attack}}''{{TS|negative||<i>)</i>}}
* Cannot be an {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Attack|Attack}} targeted by {{R|Bottled Flame}}.

If the player somehow manages to lack even a single eligible card (e.g. they have a very small deck containing only bottled cards), then the only option listed is a special {{Frame|Land}} option that has no description.

######################################################################

* In addition to the Boss dropping a {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Rare|Rare}} [[Relic]], it also drops normal combat rewards and 50 {{Asc|15|(25)}} [[Gold]].
<br>

##### Tomb_of_Lord_Red_Mask
######################################################################

=== If The Player Owns {{R|Red Mask}} ===

* The player gets to keep {{R|Red Mask}} afterwards. The [[Gold]] is purely a reward for owning the relic.

<br>

=== If The Player Does Not Own {{R|Red Mask}} ===

######################################################################
##### Neow
######################################################################

[NO OPTIONS SECTION]

{{Sequel Disambiguation}}
[[File:Neow.png|400px|center]]{{#setmainimage:Neow.png|quiet}}Neow is a large whale-like creature with light blue skin and 6 bright yellow eyes. Neow lies at the foot of the Spire and welcomes the player at the beginning of every run.

Neow blesses you based on the success of your previous run, offering [[Gold]], [[Relics]], or [[Cards]], unless you did not reach the [[Boss]] of the [[Acts#Act 1: Exordium|Exordium]], in which case she only offers two options instead of the usual four. 

== Shortlist (Two Blessings) Variant ==
If you did not reach the [[Boss]] of the [[Acts#Act 1: Exordium|Exordium]] in your last run, the Blessings she will offer are always:

* Max HP +8/6/7/7 {{Asc|14|+7/5/6/6}} ([[Ironclad]] / [[Silent]] / [[Defect]] / [[Watcher]])
* {{R|Neow's Lament}}: Enemies in the next three combats will have one health.
** If the map layout allows, you can use this to get a free shot at an [[Elite]] (colloqiually called a 'snipe').

== Standard (Four Blessings) Variant ==
If you did reach the first boss, Neow will offer you four blessings to choose from.

=== First Blessing ===
A card-related reward from the list below:

* Remove a card.
* [[Transform]] a card.
* [[Upgrade]] a card.
* Choose a card to obtain. (''Choose one of 3 random cards of your character.'')
* Choose an {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Uncommon|Uncommon}} {{QueryLink|Cards|color:Colorless|Colorless Card}} to obtain.
* Obtain a random {{QueryLink|Cards|rarity:Rare|Rare Card}}.

=== Second Blessing ===
A reward from the list below:

* Max HP +8/6/7/7 {{Asc|14|+7/5/6/6}} ([[Ironclad]] / [[Silent]] / [[Defect]] / [[Watcher]]) <!-- To verify Asc info -->
* {{R|Neow's Lament}}: Enemies in the next three combats will have one health.
* Obtain a random {{QueryLink|Relics|rarity:Common|Common Relic}}.
* Receive 100 [[Gold]].
* Obtain 3 random [[Potions]].

=== Third Blessing ===
A composite of a disadvantage and a more powerful reward. It can be a combination of any disadvantage and reward below, with any exceptions noted.

'''Disadvantages:'''
* <span class=negative-text> Lose Max HP. </span> (-8/7/7/7) {{Asc|14|(-7/6/7/6)}} ([[Ironclad]] / [[Silent]] / [[Defect]] / [[Watcher]])
* <span class=negative-text> Take X damage. </span>
** X is equal to <code>(Current HP / 10, rounded down) * 3</code>.
** The amount of damage is also affected by {{Asc|6|Ascension}} and {{Asc|14|Ascension}}.
* <span class=negative-text> Obtain a {{QueryLink|Cards|type:Curse|Curse}}. </span>
*
